title: Board of Health - February 09, 2026
meeting_location: Champlain Room, 110 Laurier Avenue West, and by electronic participation

agenda_items.title: Notices and meeting information for meeting participants and the public
agenda_items.description: Please see the attached document for public notices and meeting information, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; processes and timelines for written and oral submissions; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and remote participation details.

agenda_items.title: Roll Call
agenda_items.minutes: The meeting was called to order at 5:00 p.m by the Board Secretary. At the time of roll call, all members were present except Member Ejiofor, who joined the meeting at 5:04 p.m., and Member Gower, who joined at 5:19 p.m.

motions.motion_text: Confirmation of minutes of the meeting of December 1, 2026.

agenda_items.title: Communications
agenda_items.description: One communication item has been received (held on file with the Board of Health Secretary).

motions.motion_text: BE IT RESOLVED THAT the Chair of the Board of Health Verbal Report, the Medical Officer of Health Verbal Report, and the reports titled: Update on the Revised Ontario Public Health Standards, Emergency Management at Ottawa Public Health – Annual Update and 2026 Governance Review Report for the Ottawa Board of Health, be received and considered;AND BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED THAT the rules of procedure be suspended to permit the agenda to be amended to introduce the report titled “Election/Confirmation of the Chair and Vice-Chair for 2026” for consideration at today’s meeting.

sub_agendas_items.title: Confirmation of the Chair and Vice-Chair for 2026

attachments.attachment_title: Report - Confirmation of the Chair and Vice-Chair - 30Jan2026.pdf

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Pursuant to procedure, the Board Secretary chaired the meeting until the Board's adoption of the report titled “Confirmation of the Chair and Vice‑Chair for 2026.”
Following its approval on consent, Chair Catherine Kitts assumed the chair.

motions.motion_text: That the Board of Health for the City of Ottawa Health Unit:

sub_agendas_items.title: Chair of the Board of Health Verbal Report
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
The Chair provided a verbal update, highlighting the final year of the current Board’s term, recent participation in the Rural Ontario Municipal Association conference, and discussions with the Province regarding public health funding pressures. The Chair also noted upcoming strategic planning work, Board engagement opportunities, Council’s approval of the new Zoning By‑law and OPH’s role in promoting healthy built environments, and the observance of Black History Month.
Discussion on this item lasted approximately six minutes.

motions.motion_text: That the Board of Health for the City of Ottawa Health Unit receive this verbal report for information.

sub_agendas_items.title: Medical Officer of Health Verbal Report
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
The Medical Officer of Health provided a verbal update, noting seasonal respiratory illness trends and prevention messaging, Ottawa Public Health’s commitment to advancing Black health and addressing anti‑Black racism, new federal funding to support dementia prevention initiatives in partnership with the Ottawa Hospital Research Institute, and the upcoming retirement of a senior OPH leader, Cameron Keyes.
Discussion on this item lasted approximately seven minutes.

motions.motion_text: That the Board of Health for the City of Ottawa Health Unit receive this verbal report for information.

sub_agendas_items.title: Update on the Revised Ontario Public Health Standards

attachments.attachment_title: BOH Report_Update on the Revised OPHS_Feb 2026.pdf

motions.motion_text: That the Board of Health for the City of Ottawa Health Unit receive this report for information purposes.

sub_agendas_items.title: Emergency Management at Ottawa Public Health – Annual Update
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
The report was held to allow for one public delegation. The Board received a presentation from Mr. James Scott MacKillop, which is held on file by the Board Secretary.
There was no discussion by the Board.

motions.motion_text: That the Board of Health for the City of Ottawa Health Unit receive the Emergency Management at Ottawa Public Health – Annual Update report for information.

sub_agendas_items.title: 2026 Governance Review Report for the Ottawa Board of Health

attachments.attachment_title: Ottawa Board of Health - Code of Conduct.pdf
Ottawa Board of Health Travel Policy.pdf

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
The Board held the report to allow for Chair Kitts to provide an overview of the 2026 Governance Review, acknowledging the collaborative work undertaken to review Board by‑laws and policies in light of legislative updates, City policies, and governance best practices.
The Chair highlighted key proposed updates, including revisions to the Procedure By‑law, Delegation of Authority By‑law, Code of Conduct, Travel Policy, and Medical Officer of Health Performance Appraisal Policy, as well as the proposed adoption of the City’s Election‑Related Resources Policy. The Chair also noted the results of the Board’s governance self‑evaluation survey and upcoming follow‑up discussions.
Discussion on this item lasted approximately three minutes.

motions.motion_text: That the Board of Health for the City of Ottawa Health Unit:

BE IT RESOLVED THAT the Chair of the Board of Health Verbal Report, the Medical Officer of Health Verbal Report, and the reports titled: Update on the Revised Ontario Public Health Standards, Emergency Management at Ottawa Public Health – Annual Update and 2026 Governance Review Report for the Ottawa Board of Health, be received and adopted.
